coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices checked first. No qualifying CMS provider termination, rescission, CLIA limitation/suspension, or similar access-risk notice newer than the September 25, 2026 notices was identified.

Exactly 12 additional targeted searches were run across hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, ambulance, air-medical, rural emergency services, reopening/restoration, U.S. territories, and temporary emergency-service interruption classes.
No new qualifying U.S. or territory healthcare-access development was identified in the bounded hourly window.
